dashboard_cold_ready_ms.basis: cold shell readiness; past the 3s+ tier a launch must show named stages, and past ~4s it reads as stalled

warm_relaunch_ready_ms.basis: a relaunch that restores persisted state should stay inside the 1-3s spinner tier, never the staged-label tier

first_interaction_accepted_ms.basis: hydration to a composer that accepts input; a shell that paints but refuses typing is not ready

fleet_reveal_ms.basis: a disclosure that reveals the fleet has no spinner in its path, so it must land inside the 100ms-1s busy tier

active_context_reveal_ms.basis: selecting a repository re-anchors the workspace; same busy tier as the reveal it follows

composer_keystroke_to_paint_ms.basis: matches the operator-locked terminal keystroke p50 so both input paths answer to one bar

composer_keystroke_to_paint_p95_ms.basis: matches the operator-locked terminal keystroke p95

design_arm_ms.basis: arming a mode is direct manipulation; the armed state must settle inside the busy tier

design_hover_ms.basis: hover feedback is the 0-100ms tier — the label IS the feedback and cannot lag the pointer

design_select_ms.basis: the composer materializing after the stroke is the result of the gesture, busy tier at the outside

design_prompt_ready_ms.basis: from stroke release to a focused prompt the operator can type into

tab_switch_ms.basis: switching a workspace tab is the same class of latency as revealing a terminal; terminal tab/pane switching under load is covered by the composed terminal-workload lane

design_screenshot_crop_ms.basis: the crop that accompanies a Design Mode prompt; kept in the manifest so a missing capability reports itself instead of disappearing

repo_inventory_ms.basis: the fleet-list request the left panel waits on, at fixture scale; p50 across five consecutive calls in the operator window

repo_inventory_p95_ms.basis: the worst of those five calls; a fleet list that stalls once still stalls the operator once

soak_long_task_ms_per_minute.basis: matches the operator-locked terminal-workload long-task ceiling
